dropped.message: water 'river' is 1 deep and its carve cut 3 course(s) of ground away above its own line — a straight-sided wall from y9 to y11 at (-7, -6). The line is the lowest surface the body crosses and every column over it is emptied down to it, so a pool drawn across a slope digs a pit as deep as the ground falls. Draw it inside ground that is already level, or state a `level` and let it fill the hollow there is.
